ai_assistance: The preprocessing script that produced this file was written with the help of Claude (Anthropic), an AI assistant. The values themselves come from the NASA and USGS sources listed in DATA_SOURCES.md; no values were generated by the AI.
description: Cells of the MarsWalk cost grid that Perseverance actually drove through (NASA traverse data), sampled every 10 m along the drives.
important: A rover is not a walking astronaut: this checks how often the grid blocks terrain that NASA's rover crossed, not whether that terrain is safe to walk.
slope_note: slope_deg of each ~60 m cell is the steepest 20 m pixel inside it
